task.description: REWORK: Fix 3 failing test cases in event_store_test.zig and db_test.zig. ROOT CAUSE already diagnosed by ORCH. BUG 1 TC-ES-01-01: events table has stale idempotency_key tc-es-01-01-idem from prior crash. Fix: (a) call cleanupInstance at START of test (before insertInstance) to clear stale state; (b) remove defer block that tries to free result.record.event_type/payload/metadata - these are NOT allocator-owned (store.append uses duplicateFromParams which borrows from AppendParams slices). BUG 2 TC-ES-02-02: segfault at alloc.free(r.record.event_type) in the for-loop. Same root cause: store.append non-duplicate path returns record with event_type pointing to string literal TC_ES0202_TYPE in read-only memory. Fix: remove the if (!r.is_duplicate) { alloc.free... } block entirely from the for-loop. BUG 3 TC-DB-03-01 (db_test.zig): UnknownEventType because registry never has TC_DB0301_TYPE registered. Fix: add registry.registerType call for TC_DB0301_TYPE before store.append. Also remove the defer free block for result.record fields (same memory issue). VERIFICATION: (1) zig build exits 0. (2) With BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5433/bpm_test: zig build test exits 0, 0 failures. (3) All 3 test binaries exit 0 when run directly with BPM_TEST_DB_URL set.
acceptance_criteria: zig build test exits 0 (with BPM_TEST_DB_URL set)
TC-ES-01-01 PASS: is_duplicate=false on fresh append
TC-ES-02-02 PASS: no segfault, events sorted by sequence_number
definition_retrieval_test binary still exits 0 with BPM_TEST_DB_URL

result.summary: Fixed bad-free and stale-data bugs. Removed all alloc.free on AppendResult fields (non-heap). Added cleanupInstance pre-calls for TC-ES-01-01/03-01/04-01. Added registerType for TC_DB0301_TYPE. Fixed store.zig to return global_seq from RETURNING clause. 577 pass, 55 skip, 0 fail.
